title: Geography of Sanitation
gallery_text: Public infrastructure is not distributed evenly. This map traces the relationship between Chennai’s public toilets and its slum settlements, revealing clusters of provision alongside areas of absence.
description:
This map measures the distance between 613 public toilets and their nearest slum settlement in Chennai. 45.8% are inside or within 100 m of a slum, while 11.6% are more than 500 m away, revealing an uneven spatial distribution. It shows proximity, not actual access and the data does not capture population, usage, private toilets, capacity, condition, cost, operating status, or walking accessibility amongst many other things.

Data: Chennai Public Toilets + Chennai Slums — OpenCity / Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC). (https://opencity.in/)
